text: High molecular chemistry and physics is an interdisciplinary subject that studies the synthesis, structure, properties, and interrelationships of polymer compounds (referred to as "polymers"). It integrates theories and methods from chemistry, physics, and materials science. Polymer compounds (such as plastics, rubbers, fibers, proteins, DNA) are long-chain macromolecules formed by repeating units (monomers) through covalent bonds. They are widely present in nature (such as natural rubber, cellulose) and synthetic materials (such as polyethylene, polyester), and are the core material basis for modern industries, biomedicine, information technology, etc.
